preflight_required: target baseline and drift health response captured before Bright Data command
prompt character count and SHA-256 filled from exact text

all experiment evidence paths are fresh
canonical and managed provider-free suites pass

stop_conditions: If any provider-free preflight check fails, do not invoke Bright Data.
After one Bright Data heal attempt, preserve stdout bytes before parsing and do not retry.
If the result does not include an awaiting_approval preview, record candidate ABSENT or INCOMPLETE and stop.
If a complete candidate does not pass deterministic verification and risk, record the decision and stop.
Even if candidate verification and risk pass, do not approve, rerun, commit, roll back, or ship output without separate explicit authorization.
